title: Department of Land Resources Organises “Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath” Cleanliness Drive
body_text:
As part of the Swachhata Hi Seva initiative, the Department of Land Resources (DoLR), Ministry of Rural Development, organised a special cleanliness drive at a public park near Scope Complex, New Delhi, on 1 October 2026, under the campaign “Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath.”
The cleanliness drive witnessed enthusiastic participation from senior officials and employees of the Department. The participants came together to clean the public space, collect and dispose of waste, and contribute towards creating a cleaner and more hygienic environment.
The initiative reinforced the spirit of Swachhata Hi Seva and underscored the importance of collective action and shared responsibility in maintaining clean, healthy and well-maintained public spaces.
